assumptions: The transfer amount with dust is the amount sent by fast redeem or unstake.
The user is the caller of fast redeem or unstake.
The transfer is attempted via LayerZero OFT send.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the revert occurs on source or destination chain, so the checkpoint of transfer_succeeds cannot be pinned to a specific chain.

limitations: The plan formalizes only v_no_workaround; other impacts are handled separately.
The hardcoded-slippage condition is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states it qualitatively without a numeric tolerance.
The exact conversion rate 10^12 is used only as the divisibility divisor for the dust condition.
